$comment: A derived template (packs/README.md 'Derived templates'): the services-recurring pack composed with an Airbnb turnover crew content seed (Clean Getaway, Miami), re-registered in the memphis register with its own page skeletons. Everything structural — builders, routes, contract, tests — is the base pack's; compose expands this catalog through resolveCatalog (scripts/lib/pack-switch.mjs).
title: Cleaning & turnovers
description: A turnover-cleaning crew's site in a 90s Miami pop register: trading-card price tiles on the home page, turnover day as a photo rail, a door-hanger room-ready checklist, host testimonials, flat-priced add-ons, a line-by-line comparison, and a booking form built around check-out times — a multi-page site edited in one content file.

content.$comment: Business-content contract seed override. resolveCatalog merges a remix's content per-domain over the base's, so these seeds replace the base pack's at compose and mirror THIS remix's contentSeed module entry for entry (the remix-seed tests pin the twins).

types.name: Unit walkthrough
types.description: We walk the unit with you — in person or on video — note the host quirks, and set your checklist.

types.name: First turnover
types.description: Your first full turnover: a deep reset, the photo checklist, and your restock list started.

theme.$comment: The memphis register's brand overlay: hot pink over the flyer's bright white, with the register's own aqua and lemon as spot inks — a Miami turnover crew that reads loud and reliable at once. Marketing pages resolve brand over preset accent, so the overlay re-skins the pages and the app surfaces together. navigation re-pins the shared servicesRecurringShell chrome (a declared theme variant outranks the shell prop) to the split ink bar the flyer runs its title in; the lawncare and pest remixes pin their own.

landing.$comment: Doc-aware pack pages: routes maps each pack route to the page id its config merges under (web/app/src/View/ServicesRecurring/ServicesRecurringPage.tsx, useSitePageConfig). pages seeds each page's layout skeleton — ids match servicesRecurringLanding.ts; the platform's structural editor edits these. The preset is memphis (90s Miami pop: bright white, aqua / hot pink / lemon spot inks on black, chunky italic display with hard offset shadows, a sparse confetti layer) with the catalog's hot-pink brand overlay. The home page's middle follows the content — turnover (steps horizontal-rail) and checklist (feature-grid checklist) for the turnover story; the lawncare and pest remixes pin their own preset and pages.
